da: Her er frø til en ny dag.
Velkommen. Her dufter af nye frø.
en: Welcome. It smells of fresh seeds here.

da: Jeg hedder Nælde. Vil du se mine frø?
en: I'm Nettle. Would you like to see my seeds?
The seeds are waiting for spring.
Nettle tends the town's little seed shop.
We share seeds in the square.

da: Vil du læse det nye brev?
en: Would you read the new letter?
